phenotype_specificity.statement: Only '"IPEX"' is given as the clinical feature. FOXP3 had been excluded before study entry, and the patient was sequenced on a 462-gene panel (cohort-level). No other candidate variant is listed for S087.

quotes.quote: | S087 | 12 y | F | TNFAIP3 | AI, II | no | AD | “IPEX” |
Patients were eligible for the study if referred to SCH with clinical signs suggestive of IPEX, and hence for genetic analysis of FOXP3, but with no FOXP3 mutation identified.

segregation.statement: not reported. Cohort-level: only probands were available for initial analysis.

quotes.quote: Second, only probands were available for initial analysis, although a few families were re-contacted through the referring providers.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense variant (p.(Cys767Tyr)) at a cysteine in a zinc-finger domain according to the authors. They cite haploinsufficiency as the disease mechanism.

quotes.quote: Completely conserved site at critical cysteine in zinc finger; haploinsufficiency is causal mechanism for TNFAIP3 syndromes (PMID: 26642243)

concerns: The phenotype is only the referral label "IPEX", so there is no detail to compare with the disease.
Missense variant with no functional data and no parental testing. Table-level evidence only.
The paper does not state a transcript. hg19 position given as chr6:138202383.
